title: Isaac Corre – Event-Driven Investing at Governors Lane (EP.344)

reader_summary.headline: Isaac Corre is the founder, CEO, and Portfolio Manager of Governors Lane.
reader_summary.overview: Isaac Corre is the founder, CEO, and Portfolio Manager of Governors Lane, a hedge fund he launched in 2015 focused on event-driven strategies. Isaac describes himself as the least likely person to end up on Wall Street. Our conversation covers where event-driven investing was twenty years ago and where opportunities and challenges lie today across the disciplines of merger arbitrage, event-driven equities.

key_points.text: Isaac describes himself as the least likely person to end up on Wall Street.
